calculation_handling.description: A minaret, steeple or similar element on a place of worship may exceed the permitted maximum height by 40% if its horizontal area is at most 30.0 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: The excess is a percentage of the permitted maximum height, but height_projection_m is in metres and a pct-times-height product is not in Layer 1.

units.disclosure: The 40% height allowance for a minaret, steeple or similar element on a place of worship is not evaluated.

150.50.40.10(1).explanation: A minaret, steeple or similar architectural element on a place of worship may exceed the permitted maximum building height by 40% if its horizontal area is no more than 30.0 m2.
